title: Similarity check
lead: Compare submitted source code within one problem or across a whole contest.

scope.heading: Choose a scope
scope.lead: The scope decides which runs are created and listed.
scope.startHint: Each account may start up to 10 runs an hour.
scope.noScope: Choose a problem or a contest to see its runs.

start.queued: 202 · Queued — The new run is in the queue. The list refreshes by itself; open the run to follow its progress.
start.conflict: 409 · A run is already going — This scope has a run that is not finished yet. Wait for it to end, then start again.
start.rateLimited: 429 · Too many runs — Up to 10 runs an hour per account.

runs.empty: No runs for this scope yet.
runs.label: Runs

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.body: This contest key or run does not exist, or you cannot edit it. The server answers 404 in both cases, so there is no more detail.

summary.heading: Run summary {id}
summary.truncated: Some groups were cut short. Group {code} · {language} has {count} submissions but only the newest {compared} were compared. Pairs between older submissions do not appear.
summary.someFailed: A failed group has no pairs; the other groups still completed.
